changes: Highground now speaks German, Spanish, French, Italian, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian and Simplified and Traditional Chinese. Choose one under Shared preferences → General → Language (`/hg config general`).
Addons is one directory with each addon's switch, settings and walkthroughs, and every addon has its own sidebar section. Profiles now compare against a fixed built-in Default.
Highground uses less CPU and memory in battlegrounds, arenas, large guilds and busy raids, and Reputation's chat filter no longer stalls chat in large guilds.
Withdrawing a bounty reward, rejecting a kill report or undoing a macro change asks for a second click, and bounty sharing no longer causes repeated "No player named … is currently playing" messages.
Reputation gets an organization directory, Overview and Preferences with readable roles. On WoW Forever, capture tracking credits teammates, and discovery uses a channel per ruleset.
notice: Fully quit and restart WoW after updating: this release adds new files that /reload cannot load. On WoW Forever, everyone needs this update to find each other on the new discovery channels.
